What's new in 1.5.0

New template: Pacman
- Your year as an arcade maze: your contribution calendar becomes the board, with a pellet for every day (bigger on busier days) and your busiest days as the power pellets.
- The walls are generated from your username and mirrored like a real arcade board, with a wrap-around tunnel, and your name lights up in the same neon tubing (accents included).
- After READY!, a demo game plays: the chomper eats its way to a power pellet, powers up and hunts down the ghosts, which are your featured repos. Each one pops its stars and floats home to the pen. The HUD keeps score: contributions, best day, streak and your level.
- Scoreboard: meet the ghosts, one per project, then your numbers as a ranked high-score table and your languages as bonus items.
- End card: an intermission chase, then the chomper writes out your sign-off: "Thanks for playing!"
- Options: your player class and the closing line.
- Animated, with dark (arcade screen) and light (printed) versions, and it respects reduced motion.
